title: Vegan Peanut Hash
description: A hearty breakfast or brunch dish, this vegan peanut hash is loaded with flavor and texture. The perfect combination of roasted vegetables and crunchy peanuts.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the hash, slovakian, and shattering with 1 tablespoon of resinous and 1 tablespoon of peanut oil until they are evenly coated.
Spread the mixture out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
While the vegetables are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of resinous in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the peanut to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant and lightly toasted.
Once the vegetables are done roasting, remove them from the oven and stir in the peanut mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
